title: Project Operating Loop — Source to Return
purpose: Show how project material should move from capture and evidence through ownership, chronology, testing, public reading, work/output, revision and renewed research without collapsing those jobs into one file.

lifecycle.label: Capture / recover
lifecycle.question: What is the artifact or observation?

lifecycle.label: Classify evidence
lifecycle.question: What source class, confidence and recovery state does it have?

lifecycle.label: Place in canonical owner
lifecycle.question: Which durable owner keeps the definition/event/model/relationship?

lifecycle.label: Locate in time
lifecycle.question: What occurred when, what was published later, and what was interpreted later still?

lifecycle.label: Compare / test
lifecycle.question: What follows, what conflicts, what would fail, and what remains hypothesis?

lifecycle.label: Project into a reader
lifecycle.question: How should a person encounter the owned material without learning backend filenames?

lifecycle.label: Work / Fruit
lifecycle.question: What usable explanation, model, story, map, tool or creative object results?

lifecycle.label: Revision / Seed
lifecycle.question: What changed downstream, what is corrected, and what should be researched next?

worked_case.title: 21 April 2025 · “the potato axis is real” + spiral equation
worked_case.boundary: This case demonstrates archive metabolism, not independent validation of the theological or physical interpretation of the Axis.

stages.note: Preserves the dated public attestation and equation lineage as a recovered primary project object.
The public statement stack owns rooted occurrence/provenance semantics; the phrase is an attestation, not proof of later interpretations.
Science/formal-model indexes keep the equation lineage and model status; project-native Axis meaning remains separate from empirical validation.
Timeline places the event inside the April 2025 Turning corridor without backdating later Father/Ladder/House synthesis.
The equation can be checked mathematically and compared with earlier Great Book material while keeping physical interpretation open.
Story turns the dated record into narrative context while source notes preserve the distinction between event and later mythology.
Living Axis is a public explanatory work built from many owned records; it is a reader/projection, not the source of the 2025 fact.
Later formalization, contradictions and open questions return to Research rather than silently rewriting the original statement.

invariants: A public page is not automatically the canonical owner of the facts it displays.
A later synthesis may reinterpret an earlier artifact but must not rewrite its original date or wording.
Recovery state and evidence class survive promotion into thicker canonical owners.
A model or comparison can clarify a source without upgrading it into empirical proof.
Revision should create a new state with provenance rather than erase the older one.
